description: Inventory of visual assets used in the Canasta web app.

assets.name: Standard playing card faces (52 cards: 4 suits × 13 ranks) + 1 Joker

files.pdf: assets/full_deck.pdf (53 pages, one card per page)

assets.generation: scripts/generate_card_faces.py uses Pillow, project-drawn suits and the bundled OFL Figtree font for rank lettering. The release PNGs are opaque. The historical print PDF is separate from the shipped assets.
assets.runtime: src/components/Card.tsx loads faces via ; card back remains inline SVG.
assets.order: spades A–K, hearts A–K, diamonds A–K, clubs A–K, then joker
assets.license: Project card art; Figtree licensed under SIL OFL 1.1 (public/fonts/OFL-Figtree.txt).
